opening.id: Dengan sukacita kami mengundang Bapak/Ibu/Saudara/i untuk hadir dan berbagi kebahagiaan di hari pernikahan kami.
opening.en: With joy, we invite you to join us and share the happiness of our wedding day.

rsvpHint.id: Mohon kabari kami apakah Anda dapat hadir.
rsvpHint.en: Please let us know whether you can attend.

closing.id: Terima kasih atas doa dan kehadiran Anda.
closing.en: Thank you for your presence and kind wishes.

originality.statement: Original layout and copy written for this repository: a single-column ivory card with a generated watercolour jasmine sprig, two OFL type families and one fade on first paint. No competitor page, asset, wording or layout was used as a reference.
